dialogue.text: Good day, Mr. Schmidt. How are you today?

dialogue.speaker: User

dialogue.speaker: Robot

dialogue.text: It is called The Idiot by Elif Buttman.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Wow, sounds very interesting. You may wonder why I am here. I am here to remind you that you have a doctor appointment today, which is in another building. If you like, I could accompany you, bring you to this building.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, please. ehh, Can you bring me my shoes?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: The ones there.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I am sorry, I am seeing four pairs of shoes. Could you please describe more in detail which shoes?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: The grey thick ones.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: The grey thick ones? Alright, I got it. Here you go, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you. Can you help me put them on?

dialogue.text: Here you go, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: User

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Ah, yes, that would be great.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Thank you. All right, Mr. Schmidt. Now let's continue with the lighter weight.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Focus on the slow but steady movement and don't neglect the negative movement of this exercise.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, that's better.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Very good. I'm glad to hear this, Mr. Schmidt.
